name: Zed
author: The Zed Industries Authors
summary: High-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
description:
Zed is a next-generation code editor designed for high-performance collaboration with humans and AI.
- Written from scratch in Rust to efficiently leverage multiple CPU cores and your GPU.
- Integrate upcoming LLMs into your workflow to generate, transform, and analyze code.
- Chat with teammates, write notes together, and share your screen and project. All included.
- Zed now speaks WSL. You can open a Linux distro as a first-class “remote” target, edit projects that live inside it.
- All of Zed’s AI features, including edit predictions and ACP-powered agents, are fully supported on Windows.
- All Zed extensions now work seamlessly on Windows; no special steps, no caveats.
- To run on almost all Windows versions, including VMs, we created a new rendering backend based on DirectX 11.

versions.release_notes:
This week's release includes a Git Panel branch mode that lists every file changed since a base branch, a bookmark picker, configurable Git date formats, support for Claude Fable 5.2 for Anthropic BYOK users (plus Claude Mythos 5.2 if your organization has access), and a setting to turn off automatic agent thread titles.
Features
AI
- Added an agent.auto_generate_thread_titles setting (default true) that can be set to false to disable automatic title generation for Zed Agent threads. (#63998; thanks FrederickGeek8)
- Added support for Claude Fable 5.2 for Anthropic BYOK users, plus Claude Mythos 5.2 if your organization has access. (#66760)
- Improved the copy button on agent responses to briefly show a checkmark confirming the copy. (#64664; thanks itsfuad)
- Improved the ordering of ACP agent config options in the message editor so the first option the agent provides appears next to the send button. (#66733)
Git
- Added a branch mode to the Git Panel that lists all files changed since a base branch, such as origin/main. Choose "Compare Against Base" from the new menu at the top of the Changes tab to pick the base branch, or run git panel: show branch changes to compare against the default branch. Files in this mode can be opened as diffs but not staged or restored. (#66482)
- Added a git.date_format setting ("locale", "iso", or a strftime format such as "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") for absolute Git dates, and date_style settings ("relative" or "absolute") to choose how dates are shown in each view: git.blame.date_style, git.inline_blame.date_style, git.branch_picker.date_style, git.stash_picker.date_style, git_panel.date_style, and git_graph.date_style. (#66533; thanks scarf005)
- Added git.commit_view.expand_description and git.commit_view.expand_files settings to control whether the commit view opens with the full commit message shown and the changed files expanded. (#66331; thanks mmatczuk)
- Improved opening a commit from Git blame to scroll the commit view to the blamed file instead of the top of the diff. (#65237; thanks seongheum-choi)
- Improved Git status refresh performance in very large repositories when many files change at once. (#66242; thanks ambyjkl)
- Improved git: rename branch to trim the new branch name and replace spaces with dashes, matching branch creation, and to preview the resulting name in the rename modal. (#65734; thanks Sha1rholder)
- Improved the Git Panel's repository selector to distinguish repositories that share the same directory name. (#62800; thanks BirknerAlex)
Other
- Added a bookmark picker for browsing, searching, and previewing all bookmarks in the current workspace, opened with project bookmarks: toggle. (#60005; thanks guopenghui)
- Improved dev: open key context view by adding horizontal scrolling, so long context predicates are no longer cut off. (#66528)
Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where opening a file through the Open dialog (workspace: open) replaced the current project with one containing only that file instead of opening it as a tab in the current project. (#66103)
- Fixed a bug where switching branches in a remote project resent the full Git history over SSH, stalling the terminal and file opening until the transfer finished. (#65436; thanks azeemshaik025)
- Fixed Helix mode ignoring the vim.use_system_clipboard setting. Yank, delete and paste in Helix mode use the system clipboard by default again, as they did before 1.28. If you wish to keep the 1.28 behavior, set "vim": { "use_system_clipboard": "never" } to keep using the internal register. (#66906; thanks sandr01d)
- Fixed the file finder not showing files outside the project when searching by absolute path, and files matching file_scan_exclusions when searching by their exact path. (#66227)
- Fixed a bug where the copy button at the bottom of an agent thread could copy a response from an earlier turn when the latest turn had no response text. (#64664; thanks itsfuad)
- Fixed a bug where the read-only toggle icon and action were shown on tabs that do not support toggling read-only. (#66650)
- Fixed a crash when moving a project with a split diff to a new window. (#67128; thanks Stiven-Gjekaj)
- Fixed an empty strip at the bottom of the commit modal. (#67090; thanks keantx)
- Fixed animated WebP files only displaying their first frame when opened in the image viewer. (#66459; thanks jorge1b3)
- Fixed bold text using the wrong theme colors in Markdown previews. (#63940; thanks IbrahimKhan12)
- Fixed cmd-o opening the file dialog instead of project symbol search when using the JetBrains keymap on macOS. (#66137; thanks dmytrodanilenkov)
- Fixed combining marks such as v̄ rendering to the right of their base glyph on Linux. (#66799; thanks ItsGlucose)
- Fixed commit messages losing their line breaks in the commit view. (#66608; thanks mmatczuk)
- Fixed cmd-k (macOS) and ctrl-k (Linux/Windows) in the JetBrains keymap not focusing the commit message, including when the Git Panel was closed or showing its History tab. Pressing the key again no longer returns focus to the editor; use cmd-0 (macOS) or alt-0 (Linux/Windows) to toggle Git Panel focus. (#66330; thanks mmatczuk)
- Fixed entry icons overlapping diff stats in a narrow Git Panel. (#66278; thanks lingyaochu)
- Fixed extension snippets being duplicated each time an extension is reloaded. (#66798; thanks IbrahimKhan12)
- Fixed LM Studio and llama.cpp model discovery requests being sent at startup despite disable_ai being true. (#66842; thanks Pixelrick420)
- Fixed terminal links to absolute paths outside the project not opening when the remote's OS differs from the local one (e.g. WSL on Windows). (#66594; thanks brunocordioli072)
- Fixed the end of the Markdown preview being cut off when the file starts with a blank line or an HTML comment. (#66467; thanks yyq1025)
- Fixed the Threads Sidebar not showing a waiting indicator for threads with unanswered agent input forms. (#66708; thanks daejey)
- Fixed the zed CLI rejecting multiple ssh:// paths on the same host in a single command. (#66568; thanks kawadeomkar)
- Fixed Vim :s and :%s commands not recognizing \+ and \{n\} repetition operators in search patterns. (#66515; thanks akramcodez)
- Fixed Vim's :s without the g flag replacing the wrong matches when used after the first line. (#67015; thanks ptweezy)
- Fixed which-key closing the commit editor and pickers when a multi-key binding was pending. (#66630; thanks divyanshus2404)
- Fixed worktree index corruption when excluding symlinks that point inside a project. (#64818; thanks porada)
- Fixed zed --add --diff adding the working directory as a project folder in the focused window. (#66386; thanks abdelq)
- Fixed zed --add choosing the wrong window or project when several open projects matched equally or none matched, now preferring the focused window and its active project. (#66386; thanks abdelq)
- Fixed Zed.exe path:line being ignored on Windows when Zed is already running. (#66501; thanks h4nz4)
- Fixed zed://file and file:// links with a drive letter (for example zed://file/C:/project/main.rs:12) opening an empty window on Windows. (#66497; thanks h4nz4)

This week's release includes optional automatic Git fetching, a resizable Refs column in the Git Graph, dragging Git Panel files into terminals and editors, and mouse-wheel font zoom in diff views and terminals.
Features
AI
- Added an edit_predictions.button setting to toggle the edit prediction button in the status bar. (#66450; thanks z0al)
- Improved compatibility with the latest Agent Client Protocol, including handling of missing sessions, plan updates, diff formats, and cancellation of permission requests. (#66425)
- Improved the Agent's read_file tool output by truncating lines longer than 2,000 characters to prevent context window overflow. (#65395; thanks Antphar)
- Improved subagent cards so that full screen opens a finished subagent run at its start. (#66252)
Git
- Added optional automatic fetching of the current branch's upstream remote and the default branch's remote. Enable it with git.auto_fetch.enabled; configure the interval with git.auto_fetch.interval_secs (60 seconds by default). Automatic fetching is disabled by default. (#53089; thanks andriygm)
- Added a resizable "Refs" column to the Git Graph that can be toggled on or off from the column header's context menu. (#66260; thanks RemcoSmitsDev)
- Added support for dragging files from the Git Panel to the terminal and editor panes. (#66423; thanks mmatczuk)
- Added support for searching by branch name in the worktree picker. (#66384; thanks michelinux)
Debugger
- Added support for configuring the debugger panel’s default size via debugger.default_width and debugger.default_height. (#66435)
Languages
- Improved call hierarchy readability by adding spacing between item names and details. (#66144; thanks yskim308)
Linux
- Improved window startup time on Linux with NVIDIA GPUs. (#66002; thanks runsonmypc)
Other
- Added support for mouse-wheel font zoom in diff views and terminals with mouse_wheel_zoom enabled: cmd-scroll on macOS and ctrl-scroll on Linux/Windows. (#66296; thanks ndri)
- Improved responsiveness when navigating code, loading completion details, and comparing files. (#66487)
- Improved the reliability of language server and agent downloads with consistent checksum verification, rejection of failed HTTP responses, and better cleanup of partial downloads. (#66048)
Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where launching Zed on Windows while it was already running prevented the previous session from being restored. (#66364; thanks somtri)
- Fixed Agent context compaction unnecessarily using uncached input tokens with supported providers, including OpenAI and xAI. (#64938; thanks tidely)
- Fixed auto-compaction only running once during a long agent turn, which could let the thread exceed the model's context window. (#66215)
- Fixed compaction not reusing the prompt cache for ChatGPT subscription models. (#66527)
- Fixed creating pull requests from Zed for Forgejo remotes, including Codeberg. (#66182; thanks Lachstec)
- Fixed external agents sometimes starting without MCP servers configured in user settings when the thread was created before the project folder finished loading. (#64612; thanks philwinder)
- Fixed Helix mode operations overwriting the system clipboard when vim.use_system_clipboard was set to "always". (#55455; thanks SrGaabriel)
- Fixed local files opening as empty buffers in remote workspaces. (#65771; thanks Huliiiiii)
- Fixed mentioning, sharing, and deleting project skills in remote workspaces. (#66207)
- Fixed Project Search buttons affecting the wrong pane when clicked in an unfocused split. (#50882; thanks transitoryangel)
- Fixed registry agents installed via npm (such as Claude Agent) failing to launch with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND after an interrupted or concurrent install. (#66235)
- Fixed remote terminals and tasks failing on Windows SSH servers whose default shell is Nushell. (#65580; thanks lingyaochu)
- Fixed remote workspaces sharing a directory being merged into one workspace after restarting Zed. (#66289; thanks buvidk1234)
- Fixed SSH connections failing with "Missing remote shell" when the remote shell's startup reads from stdin. (#66737)
- Fixed SSH connections to macOS hosts getting stuck on "Starting Proxy" when the remote server cannot access the system pasteboard. (#66736)
- Fixed stale language server data being shown in multibuffers. (#66264)
- Fixed SVG images failing to render in Markdown previews for remote projects. (#66404; thanks max1ab)
- Fixed synthetic mouse movements on Windows repositioning the editor cursor when the window repainted, such as when opening the command palette. (#55739; thanks khaledtf19)
- Fixed the Git Panel showing “No Git Repositories” after removing the active repository’s project folder from a remote workspace while other repositories remained open. (#66299; thanks buvidk1234)
- Fixed the global busy cursor lingering after Zed opened on GNOME Wayland. (#64058; thanks eukreign)
- Fixed the skill creator saving project skills to the local machine instead of the remote in remote workspaces. (#66224)
- Fixed wide submenus and popovers covering the menu or button they open from. (#66496)
- Fixed worktree task hooks running when a workspace was in restricted mode. (#66284)
- Fixed a bug where document color inlays were duplicated when switching the lsp_document_colors setting between inlay and border or background. (#66732)
- Fixed a missing scrollbar in the Open Remote picker, making additional remote servers easier to discover. (#63909)
- Fixed AI features and edit predictions continuing to use an organization after you were removed from it. (#66494)
- Fixed an issue where using pane: reveal in project panel after closing the last terminal tab would unexpectedly reopen the terminal panel. (#66472)
- Fixed author names and avatars being vertically misaligned in the Git Graph. (#66187; thanks albertbogusz)
- Fixed call hierarchy hover tooltips not showing full details, including package paths, when rows were truncated. (#66144; thanks yskim308)
- Fixed false missing-property warnings for CodeLLDB debug configurations using build-based target inference. (#64133; thanks ZhehooMorgen)
- Fixed images in the Markdown preview being rendered with rounded corners. (#65474; thanks OmChillure)
- Fixed missing syntax highlighting for C++ lambda specifiers and the defined preprocessor operator. (#66406; thanks riddhigupta1110)
- Fixed Remote Projects rejecting SSH commands whose ssh executable was shell-quoted. (#66360; thanks zozo123)
- Fixed square corners showing on terminal tool cards in the Agent Panel with themes whose element background differed from the panel background. (#66367; thanks fuzzcan)
- Fixed tasks that use file variables such as $ZED_FILE not being listed in task: spawn when a single file is opened without a folder. (#66195; thanks graduss)
- Fixed the History tab in the Git Panel losing the highlight on the open commit when clicking into the commit view. (#66226)
- Fixed Windows shell detection for executable names containing uppercase letters. (#66387; thanks M0-kii)

This week's release includes syntax highlighting for Go 1.27 generic methods, an option to open README files by default, and AI commit messages that follow your repository's recent commit style.
Features
AI
- Improved Agent Panel memory usage by loading tool-call diffs and parsing thread message Markdown only when first viewed, instead of when loading a thread. (#65444, #65470; thanks Vanuan)
- Improved AI commit message generation by using the three most recent repository commit messages as style examples. (#61528; thanks matheuslrd)
- Improved CPU usage and disk reads while the agent was working, especially with a long thread history. (#66015)
Git
- Added missing tooltips to the close, commit message, and "View on" buttons in the Git Graph's commit details panel. (#66016; thanks skmanoj322)
- Improved Git Graph rendering performance. (#66180; thanks RemcoSmitsDev)
- Improved the Git Panel's error message when a push was rejected because the local branch was behind the remote, explaining that remote changes must be fetched and integrated before pushing again. (#47296; thanks Aladiah96)
Languages
- Added syntax highlighting for Go 1.27 generic methods. (#64562; thanks ndellosa95)
Other
- Added an option to open README files by default by setting on_new_window to "readme". (#65389)
- Improved the Project Panel error message when moving a file or folder onto a location where one with the same name already existed. (#64344; thanks zaugust4891)
Bug Fixes
- Fixed Solargraph completions crashing Zed in certain cases. (#66157)
- Fixed "Zed quit unexpectedly" appearing when quitting with cmd-q on macOS. (#66158)
- Fixed a crash when Tree-sitter syntax highlighting failed. (#66474)
- Fixed a crash when adding surrounding characters (m s) to adjacent selections in Helix mode. (#66107; thanks bugprone)
- Fixed a hang in Vim visual-block mode at the end of a wrapped file. (#66118)
- Fixed child filesystem watches losing events when a covering parent watch was removed. (#65998)
- Fixed collapsed inline diff hunks producing invalid word-diff highlights for multibyte UTF-8 text. (#65829; thanks Blazearth)
- Fixed external agents' tool call locations opening one line below the line the agent reported. (#66110)
- Fixed Git Graph rendering lagging behind when opening or closing the commit details panel. (#66132; thanks RemcoSmitsDev)
- Fixed inline review switching to a subagent's edits when the subagent started. (#66093)
- Fixed language server formatting requests sometimes applying incorrect changes. (#65856)
- Fixed language server setup failing with EBADDEVENGINES in Yarn and pnpm projects. (#65280; thanks latin-1)
- Fixed language servers receiving change and save notifications for files outside their dynamically registered document selectors, including unrelated files in the project. (#65253; thanks aviatesk)
- Fixed LLM credentials being read when disable_ai was set to true. (#66029)
- Fixed missed filesystem events for case-insensitive watches registered with trailing separators or equivalent path spellings. (#65995)
- Fixed missing Git repository, worktree, and branch names in the title bar for Windows remote projects opened in a repository subfolder. (#66142; thanks lingyaochu)
- Fixed missing thinking output from OpenAI-compatible Responses endpoints that emitted reasoning-text events. (#65938)
- Fixed on-type formatting after pressing enter being applied before the new line's indentation, which left the cursor after text inserted by language servers such as Ruby LSP. (#65769; thanks JacobNWolf)
- Fixed remote projects (SSH, WSL) becoming unresponsive when loading an agent thread that referred to many files outside the project. (#65189; thanks coinman-dev)
- Fixed renaming files, creating files, and renaming terminal tabs being cancelled when focus_follows_mouse was enabled and the mouse moved. (#66167)
- Fixed retryable provider failures in OpenAI-compatible chat streams not being recognized as retryable. (#66038)
- Fixed right-click menus and popup pickers closing when the mouse moved to another pane with focus_follows_mouse enabled. (#66173)
- Fixed sandboxed agent terminal commands incorrectly reporting failure under dash on Linux. (#64439; thanks NHendrickson9616)
- Fixed SSH connections failing when usernames containing / or \ were percent-encoded. (#64744; thanks ryanabx)
- Fixed status bar panel buttons doing nothing when another panel in the same dock was zoomed. (#66119; thanks ybelmach)
- Fixed streaming connection failures being classified as non-retryable errors for Google AI and OpenAI Responses model requests. (#65940)
- Fixed the automatically installed Delve debugger for Go not updating after its initial installation. (#66025)
- Fixed changes to focus_follows_mouse not applying to docks until Zed was restarted. (#66161)
- Fixed deleted files remaining in the File Finder's history. (#65660)
- Fixed duplicating files or folders in the Project Panel overwriting clipboard contents. (#60894; thanks shindgew)
- Fixed external stash renames not being reflected in the stash picker. (#55294)
- Fixed failed model-list fetches, such as those caused by invalid or expired API keys, being silently dropped instead of logged for Anthropic, Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, OpenRouter, and Vercel AI Gateway. (#64171; thanks somtri)
- Fixed language servers' dynamically registered capabilities applying to files outside their document selector's pattern. (#65252; thanks aviatesk)
- Fixed long recent project names and the Open Project shortcut overflowing on the Welcome screen and in narrow panels. (#65531; thanks junkmailkeep)
- Fixed pasting in Helix select mode with shift-r, space p, or cmd-v not returning to normal mode. (#65492; thanks raum-dellamorte)
- Fixed project entries reappearing in Recent Projects after removal. (#66127; thanks EcutAtom336)
- Fixed project names in the title bar for repo.git bare clones on remote Windows hosts. (#66199; thanks lingyaochu)
- Fixed reordering a Markdown editor tab switching back to Markdown preview when "Open Markdown Files in Preview" was enabled. (#65795; thanks mateioprea)
- Fixed running Go tests on Windows failing with an invalid-directory error. (#65722; thanks giocld)
- Fixed scrollbar settings not applying to already open terminals, panels, and menus until they were reopened. (#66017)
- Fixed unnecessary-code dimming sometimes disappearing when code_lens and semantic_tokens: "full" were both enabled. (#56003)
Breaking Changes and Notices
- Removed support for macOS Catalina and Big Sur. Zed now requires macOS 12.0 (Monterey) or later. (#65994)
- Removed agent checkpoints and the "Restore Checkpoint" button. Taking a checkpoint before every message made the agent slow to respond, or hang, in large Git repositories. To undo the agent's changes, reject its edits or use Git. (#65989)

This week's release includes Pyrefly as an optional built-in Python language server, the ability to expand and inspect nested variable values directly in debugger hovers, and DWARF debugging for WebAssembly sources in the JavaScript debugger.
Features
AI
- Improved ACP configuration defaults to apply only to new conversations, preserving session settings when reopening existing conversations. (#65850)
- Improved fuzzy searching in agent model and configuration option pickers for Zed Agent and third-party ACP agents, while keeping search preparation off the UI thread. (#64147; thanks JacobNWolf)
- Improved OpenCode compatibility when replaying DeepSeek reasoning and disabling thinking for Google models. (#65922)
- Improved thinking controls to explain when thinking cannot be disabled at the selected effort level. (#62480)
Debugger
- Added DWARF debugging to the JavaScript debugger to support debugging WebAssembly sources. (#65371; thanks SGumbles)
- Improved debugger hovers with an expandable, keyboard-accessible variable tree. (#53198; thanks Tortes)
Languages
- Added Pyrefly as an optional built-in Python language server, available when enabled in the Python language_servers setting. (#44262; thanks grievejia)
- Improved restarting language servers after stopping them with the LSP button. (#65387)
- Improved SQL syntax highlighting in Rust sql! string literals. (#58778; thanks kuskhan)
Remote Development
- Improved SSH reconnections by starting the resync timeout only after the handshake completes. (#65457; thanks Huliiiiii)
macOS
- Added support for the Display P3 color space on macOS with the use_display_p3 setting. (#64394; thanks MDalstrom)
Other
- Added an extension option to project_panel.sort_order to group files by extension. (#65776; thanks Carnage725)
- Improved fuzzy search ranking in the File Finder. (#59224; thanks feitreim)
Bug Fixes
- Fixed discarding unstaged changes in the Git Panel also discarding staged changes. (#65559; thanks stezu)
- Fixed hangs when restoring agent threads with subagents. (#65177)
- Fixed a crash in the Agent Panel when mentioning a file whose name contains a line break, and improved how those mentions display line breaks. (#65693)
- Fixed a bug where cancelling the save-changes prompt while removing a project from the sidebar still removed it from the recent projects list. (#65683; thanks mateioprea)
- Fixed agent authentication overwriting drafts. (#65844)
- Fixed agent configuration defaults being saved before acceptance or ignoring the agent's returned value. (#65849)
- Fixed duplicated thinking text from OpenAI-compatible providers that send both reasoning and reasoning_content. (#65926)
- Fixed file links with line numbers failing to open WSL files when using Zed on Windows. (#66089; thanks buvidk1234)
- Fixed file icons not appearing for stem-based filename variants. (#51891; thanks bryanpth)
- Fixed Google AI invalid API keys being classified as invalid requests instead of authentication errors. (#65885)
- Fixed IME composition text not being underlined in single-line inputs and editors with diagnostics turned off. (#65610; thanks Sha1rholder)
- Fixed issues detecting local and remote environment variables when using PowerShell (pwsh). (#66097)
- Fixed JSON completion ordering for enum values in settings.json. (#65589; thanks ragen1337)
- Fixed Markdown preview tabs for files with the same name not showing their directory. (#65736; thanks gitKashish)
- Fixed Mistral Large 4 responses failing when used through an OpenAI-compatible provider. (#65915)
- Fixed OpenCode requests failing for Claude models that use adaptive thinking block binding. (#65925)
- Fixed pasting a screenshot into the Agent Panel or inline assistant inserting the image twice or alongside its temporary file path. (#65626; thanks qystishere)
- Fixed queued messages in the Agent Panel becoming unreadable when the panel was narrow. (#65638; thanks 0froq)
- Fixed Rust task and debugger variables for files outside Cargo projects. (#65684; thanks shoyann)
- Fixed touchscreen scrolling using the previous swipe's axis when a new touch interrupts momentum scrolling. (#64239; thanks huacnlee)
- Fixed trusting projects on remote Windows machines from Unix systems. (#63102; thanks lingyaochu)

verification.label: Hashes copied from upstream package manifests (winget-pkgs, Homebrew cask). Not independently re-computed; signatures not checked. Linux (Flatpak) installs come from Flathub, whose repository is signed; Flathub publishes no file checksum.
